---
title: "Capture controls"
description: "Select a document, start capture, and control the camera."
---

## Select a document

Initialization loads the scan’s current selection and available choices without opening the camera.

Build the country picker from any ISO 3166 alpha-2 list; the server rejects countries the venue does not accept. Selecting a country loads its permitted document types:

```typescript
capture.update({ country: selectedCountry });
```

Use `state.allowedDocumentTypes` for the document picker:

```typescript
capture.update({ documentType: selectedDocumentType });
```

Both choices come from the scan’s venue policy. You can also supply them when [creating the scan](/external/api/create-scan).

## Start capture

After selection, the SDK enters `Phase.READY`. Call `start()` to open the camera:

```typescript
capture.start();
```

`state.phase` identifies the requested side (`CAPTURING_FRONT` or `CAPTURING_REAR`), `state.reading` what the SDK is decoding, and `state.guidance` reports capture feedback. The SDK captures automatically and advances through the required sides.

## Manual capture

```typescript
capture.capture();
```

Available during `Phase.CAPTURING_FRONT` and `Phase.CAPTURING_REAR`.

## Flashlight

Use `onTorchChange` to receive flashlight availability and its enabled state. When available:

```typescript
await capture.setTorch(!torch.enabled);
```

## Stop and release

`stop()` releases the camera while preserving the instance. `start()` resumes it. Call `destroy()` when leaving capture.
